name: Miranda Cosgrove
source:
"Don't do anything I wouldn't do."

Age: It's a secret

Mira is a flirty, fun-loving bombshell. Just don't let her looks or words fool you. Get close and you'll find a girl with her own moral standards and fierce loyalty.

[From [url=http://synokoria.tumblr.com/Valentines_Otome]Valentines Otome official site[/url]]
